discard.title: Discard job?

url.placeholder: Paste a link, a playlist or a list of links…
url.label: URLs
url.helper: One URL per line. Enter adds, Shift+Enter starts a new line. Paste or drop links anywhere.
url.noneFound: No links found in that text.
url.addFailedSome: {failed} of {total} links could not be added
folder.timeout: The folder chooser did not respond.
folder.manual.title: Choose a folder
folder.manual.label: Absolute folder path
folder.manual.hint: Used when no desktop folder picker is available (xdg-desktop-portal, zenity or kdialog).
folder.manual.invalid: Enter an absolute path starting with /
error.hint.needs_browser_cookies: The site blocked the request (login wall, bot check or Cloudflare challenge). Open the page in your browser once, then set Cookies → from browser in Settings and retry. A yt-dlp with browser impersonation (curl_cffi, see the Toolchain panel) gets past many Cloudflare checks without cookies.
error.hint.needs_js_runtime: yt-dlp needs a JavaScript runtime for this site. Install deno (≥ 2.3) or node (≥ 22) and check the Toolchain panel.
error.hint.timeout: The probe took too long. Check the network, or raise the probe timeout in Settings.
error.hint.geo_blocked: The site reports this media is not available in your region. A proxy in Settings may help.
error.hint.not_found: The media could not be found; it may have been removed.
error.hint.toolchain_missing: yt-dlp was not found. Open the Toolchain panel and choose Install / update yt-dlp.
error.hint.unsupported_url: yt-dlp does not support this URL and the page sniffer found no media.
duplicate.label: Already queued
duplicate.title: This link is already in the queue
duplicate.body: An active or queued download uses the same URL. Add it again anyway?
discard.batchCompletedBody: This removes the selected jobs from the queue only. Files on disk will not be deleted.
discard.batchUnfinishedBody: {count} unfinished job(s) will have their Job Destination files deleted. Completed jobs keep their files.
queue.col.title: Title
queue.tier.genericHint: yt-dlp has no dedicated extractor for this site; the generic one was used.
queue.tier.sniffHint: Media was found by scanning the page HTML.
queue.mirror.title: Add mirror
queue.mirror.label: Mirror URL
queue.cap.title: Speed limit
queue.cap.label: Limit in KB/s (0 removes the limit)
queue.cap.failed: Could not set the speed limit
probe.generic.title: Generic extraction
probe.generic.body: yt-dlp has no dedicated extractor for this site. Results come from its generic extractor and the quality list may be incomplete.
probe.sniff.title: Found by scanning the page
probe.sniff.body: yt-dlp could not extract this page, so media links found in its HTML are offered instead.
probe.file.title: Plain file
probe.file.body: The server returned a file rather than a web page; it will be downloaded as is.
probe.plainFailed: Could not queue a plain download
probe.media.noFfmpeg: ffmpeg was not found: options that embed or remux are disabled.
history.title: History
history.filter.label: Show
history.clearConfirmBody: This removes the shown entries from History. Downloaded files stay on disk.
settings.title: Settings
settings.loadFailed.detail: Apply stays disabled until it loads, so saved values are not replaced by defaults.
libraryRoot.warning: Library Root loaded with a problem
settings.libraryRoot.hint: Default parent folder for download jobs. Each job gets its own subfolder.
settings.transfers.hint: How many downloads run at once and how fast they may go.
settings.quality.hint: Pre-selected when a probe lists several qualities. You can still change each item.
settings.template.hint: Variables: %(title)s, %(id)s, %(uploader)s, %(upload_date)s, %(ext)s. Used for yt-dlp downloads; plain files keep their URL name.
settings.extras.hint: Defaults for the media options in the probe sheet. Embedding and remuxing need ffmpeg.
settings.cookies.hint: Some sites need your browser session (age or login walls, Cloudflare challenges). Pick the browser you are signed in with, or point to a cookies.txt file.
settings.proxy.hint: http, socks4 or socks5 URL used for page fetches, downloads and yt-dlp. Leave empty for a direct connection.
settings.tiers.hint: For sites outside the built-in list: try yt-dlp's generic extractor, then scan the page for media, then treat the link as a file.
settings.notifications.desktop: Desktop notifications when a download finishes
toolchain.title: Toolchain
toolchain.hint: yt-dlp does the extraction; ffmpeg merges and converts; a JavaScript runtime lets yt-dlp solve YouTube's challenges.
toolchain.ytdlpMissing: Install the yt-dlp package or use Install below.
toolchain.ffmpegMissing: Needed for HLS, merging and remuxing.
toolchain.jsMissing: Install deno (2.3 or newer) or node (22 or newer).
toolchain.blocked: Downloads are running; try again when the queue is idle.
toolchain.deferred: The update will be applied when the queue is idle.
toolchain.settingsFailed.detail: Saving and pinning stay disabled until they load, so your pins are not cleared.
toolchain.statusFailed: Could not read the toolchain state
toolchain.saveFailed: Could not save the update settings
toolchain.nightlyChannel: Use nightly yt-dlp builds (fixes site changes sooner)
toolchain.pinHelper: Leave empty to follow the latest.
toolchain.rolledBack: Rolled back to the previous version
folder.manual.noChooser: No folder chooser was found. Install xdg-desktop-portal, zenity or kdialog to get one, or type the folder path here.
toolchain.impersonationMissing: Needs curl_cffi. Some sites (for example luxuretv) are only reachable with it or with browser cookies.
